papers.title: Vasoactive Intestinal Polypeptide-Expressing Interneurons in the Hippocampus Support Goal-Oriented Spatial Learning.

pipeline_steps.technique: Cre-dependent viral strategy for cell-type-specific labeling and bidirectional optogenetic manipulation of VIP+ (and comparison PV+/SOM+) interneurons

parameters.mouse_lines: VIP-IRES-Cre, Pvalb-IRES-Cre, Som-IRES-Cre, crossed with Ai9 tdTomato reporter

pipeline_steps.output_data_type: mice with cell-type-restricted GCaMP6f/opsin expression

pipeline_steps.technique: Stereotaxic viral injection and chronic hippocampal CA1 imaging window/headpost implantation

parameters.coordinates: -2.2 AP, 1.6 ML, -1.2/-1.1/-1.0 DV relative to bregma
parameters.injection: 20-30 nl per DV site via Nanoject II
parameters.window: 3.0 mm diameter, 1.5 mm height cannula with 3 mm glass coverslip

pipeline_steps.output_data_type: chronic optical access over dorso-intermediate hippocampus

pipeline_steps.technique: Bilateral chronic optical fiber implantation for head-fixed optogenetic manipulation

parameters.laser_sources: 593.5 nm or 473 nm laser diode (CrystaLaser), 20 mW at fiber tip

pipeline_steps.output_data_type: mice with chronic bilateral optical access for CA1 photostimulation

pipeline_steps.technique: In vivo two-photon calcium imaging of VIP+ interneurons and/or CA1 pyramidal cells during head-fixed behavior

parameters.excitation: 50-100 mW, 920 nm (Chameleon Ultra II) or 940 nm (Insight X3)

pipeline_steps.output_data_type: raw two-photon GCaMP6f/tdTomato time series

pipeline_steps.technique: Simultaneous two-photon calcium imaging and local field potential recording via a contralateral chronic silicon probe

parameters.probe: 4-site silicon probe (Qtrode, Neuronexus), 45 degree angle, contralateral CA1
parameters.coordinates: -2.3 mm AP, 2.75 mm ML, -0.975 mm DV
parameters.recording: Intan Technologies multichannel system, 25 kHz downsampled to 1250 Hz, synchronized with 2P microscope

pipeline_steps.output_data_type: synchronized VIP+ IN calcium activity and CA1 LFP
pipeline_steps.hardware: Qtrode silicon probe; Intan Technologies recording system

pipeline_steps.technique: Simultaneous two-photon calcium imaging and LED photostimulation for causal manipulation of VIP+ IN activity during imaging

parameters.synchronization: custom electronics triggering light pulses during galvanometer flyback (no active acquisition)
parameters.virus_combinations: bReaChES-tdTomato+CaMKII-GCaMP6f (activation) or ArchT-tdTomato+CaMKII-GCaMP6f (inhibition), vs. tdTomato+CaMKII-GCaMP6f control

pipeline_steps.output_data_type: CA1 pyramidal cell calcium activity under VIP+ IN optogenetic activation/inhibition

pipeline_steps.technique: In vitro whole-cell current-clamp recording from CA1 pyramidal cells with ArchT-mediated optogenetic silencing of VIP+ IN input during Schaffer-collateral stimulation

parameters.slicing: 400 um transverse sections, Leica VT1200S vibratome, high-sucrose dissection solution
parameters.internal_solution: 130 mM K-gluconate, 8 mM KCl, 10 mM HEPES, 4 mM NaCl, 4 mM Mg2ATP, 0.3 mM Tris2GTP, 14 mM phosphocreatine
parameters.amplifier: MultiClamp 700B, Digidata 1440A, 50 kHz digitization, 1 kHz low-pass filter
parameters.stimulation: Schaffer-collateral electrical stimulation paired with 532 nm laser (OptoEngine) on alternating sweeps

pipeline_steps.output_data_type: whole-cell IPSP recordings with/without VIP+ IN silencing

pipeline_steps.technique: Head-fixed treadmill behavior tasks: Random Foraging (RF) and Goal-Oriented Learning (GOL) with cued/cue-less belts and a multisensory context

parameters.apparatus: 2-m treadmill belt with water port and lick/position recording electronics
parameters.rf_task: randomly delivered rewards, 3x10 min sessions/day for 2-3 days
parameters.gol_task: fixed 10-cm reward zone (>=10 cm from nearest tactile cue), 3x10 min sessions/day for 3 days
parameters.cued_belt: 3 fabric segments with distinct tactile cues
parameters.multisensory_context: constant odor, blinking red LED (1 Hz), 2 kHz auditory tone

pipeline_steps.output_data_type: trained mice performing RF/GOL tasks with recorded lick/position data

pipeline_steps.technique: Optogenetic manipulation protocol during GOL behavior to test effects of VIP+ IN activity on learning, with safety timeout

parameters.stimulation_zone: 70 cm segment centered on reward zone
parameters.safety: 15 s timeout to shut off light if mouse remained in reward zone
parameters.cuing_control: continuous matching-color ambient LED to prevent light cuing

pipeline_steps.output_data_type: behavioral and imaging data under VIP+ IN optogenetic modulation during learning

pipeline_steps.technique: Post hoc neurochemical identification of imaged VIP+ interneurons via CCK/calretinin immunostaining registered to the two-photon field of view

parameters.imaging: Leica SP5 confocal, Z-stack visually matched to recorded FOV

pipeline_steps.output_data_type: neurochemical identity (CCK+/CR+) of individually imaged VIP+ INs

pipeline_steps.technique: Immunocytochemical validation of VIP-IRES-Cre mouse line specificity via VIP/RFP double labeling

parameters.antigen_retrieval: 10 mM sodium citrate + 0.05% Tween-20, pH 6.0, 95C 45 min
parameters.quantification: double-labeled cell counts on max Z-projections, 3-4 slices/mouse

pipeline_steps.output_data_type: quantified VIP/Cre-reporter double-labeling specificity

pipeline_steps.technique: Monosynaptic retrograde rabies tracing of inputs to VIP+ interneurons

parameters.rabies: EnvA-pseudotyped CVS-N2cdG-GFP, injected 2 weeks after priming
parameters.quantification: GFP+ cell counting on stereoscope images (Nikon SMZ18) referenced to Paxinos atlas; starter cells counted on confocal Z-stacks

pipeline_steps.output_data_type: mapped presynaptic input neurons to VIP+ IN starter cells
pipeline_steps.hardware: Nikon SMZ18 stereoscope; Leica SP5 confocal microscope

pipeline_steps.technique: Calcium imaging preprocessing: motion correction, ROI segmentation, neuropil correction, and DF/F calculation

parameters.roi_segmentation: hand-segmented on time-averaged images in ROI Buddy or ImageJ
parameters.neuropil_correction: FISSA, 6 neuropil subregions, alpha=0.2, 7 signal components (CA1PC ROIs)
parameters.df_f_baseline: Jia et al. method, tau1=1s (PC)/10s (IN) smoothing, tau2=15s (PC)/100s (IN) baseline window

pipeline_steps.output_data_type: motion-corrected, neuropil-corrected DF/F traces

pipeline_steps.technique: Behavioral-event-triggered response quantification (locomotion, reward, running-stop) and transient area-under-curve analysis, with bootstrap significance testing

parameters.response_window: 3 s pre/post event, mean DF/F post minus pre
parameters.auc: sum of Ca2+ signal over transient duration, normalized by frame rate
parameters.bootstrap: 3000-iteration resampling with replacement, two-tailed 99% confidence interval for significance

pipeline_steps.input_data_type: DF/F traces with behavioral event timestamps
pipeline_steps.output_data_type: per-cell event response magnitudes and significance calls

pipeline_steps.technique: Velocity cross-correlation analysis and classification of VIP+ INs into positively/negatively velocity-modulated (PVM/NVM) groups

parameters.classification: PVM if peak cross-correlation positive, NVM if negative
parameters.cross_session_averaging: cross-registered cells averaged across recording sessions

pipeline_steps.output_data_type: PVM/NVM classification and peak/lag values per cell

pipeline_steps.technique: Ridge-regression generalized linear model of VIP+ IN activity from behavioral covariates with cross-validated log-likelihood-ratio variable-group importance

parameters.predictors: velocity, running-start, running-stop, licking, position (100 binary spatial bins), reward
parameters.model: ridge regression, 10-fold cross-validation on 100 s blocks/10 s intervals
parameters.variable_importance: base-2 log-likelihood ratio between full and reduced (variable-group-excluded) models on held-out data, normalized by information gained (bits/sample)

pipeline_steps.input_data_type: DF/F traces and behavioral covariate time series
pipeline_steps.output_data_type: GLM fit quality (r2) and per-variable-group information gain

pipeline_steps.technique: Place-cell detection, place-field fitting, and reward-zone enrichment analysis

parameters.spatial_info_test: Skaggs spatial information, 1000-iteration shuffle, 95th percentile threshold
parameters.place_field_fitting: Gaussian curve fit to each local rate-map maximum, fields <50% of largest Gaussian area discarded
parameters.enrichment_test: one-sample t-test on fraction of place cells within 15% of belt nearest reward vs. expected uniform fraction
parameters.group_comparison: two-way ANOVA with paired/unpaired t-test and Bonferroni correction

pipeline_steps.output_data_type: detected place fields and reward-zone enrichment statistics

pipeline_steps.technique: Design of custom electrophysiology hardware: monopolar hippocampal LFP/EMG electrode and a custom multichannel video-EEG recording system for simultaneous monitoring of up to 16 mice

parameters.electrode: custom monopolar electrode for hippocampal LFP and neck EMG signals
parameters.recording_system: custom analog multichannel recording system (NeuraLynx-based), customized for simultaneous recording of up to 16 mice

pipeline_steps.output_data_type: custom electrophysiology recording hardware
pipeline_steps.hardware: custom monopolar electrode; NeuraLynx-based multichannel recording system

parameters.function: voltage regulation and connector routing for downstream reward/cue devices and sensors
parameters.io: 13 digital and 5 analog I/O connectors, Ethernet adapter for LAN communication

pipeline_steps.output_data_type: custom Behavior Controller printed circuit board

pipeline_steps.technique: Custom PCB design for the Position Controller (quadrature decoder circuit, 16-bit tick counter, oscillator)

parameters.components: onboard quadrature decoder, 16-bit counter, 10 MHz oscillator
parameters.performance: capable of counting >4096-tick/turn encoders at >1000 RPM

pipeline_steps.output_data_type: custom Position Controller printed circuit board
